title: I Tried Faceless YouTube Automation for 30 Days Realistic Results
summary: Thirty-day faceless YouTube test from zero: fourteen AI-assisted videos, a hundred subscribers, under a hundred dollars in affiliate revenue for thirty-plus hours.

assertions.quote: Automation doesn't mean zero effort. It means smart effort.
I made $94 in 30 hours of work. That's about $3 per hour.
You're not relying on AdSense. You can monetize through affiliate links from day one.
I knew YouTube needs time to understand your content and find your audience

verdicts.note: Recommendation systems need watch data before surfacing a new channel.

assertions.quote: specific titles like this free AI tool writes better than chat GPT got way more traction

verdicts.note: Click-through differences for specific versus generic titles are widely reported by creators.

assertions.quote: Those 14 videos will keep generating views and revenue for months, maybe years.
Main channel Matt runs multiple faceless channels that generate 5 figures per month

verdicts.note: Some operators reach this; it is self-reported and the speaker is selling a course.
Most faceless channels never reach monetization, and five-figure monthly claims come from operators selling courses.
